resources.string: Not connected — everything stays on this phone
A FediFerry server keeps a project\'s library, drafts and channels in one place, so several phones can work on them together. Ask whoever runs the server for its address and a project token.
For example fediferry.example.org. Use https:// from outside your home network.
Starts with ffp_. It opens the project, so keep it private.
That is not a server address.
The server does not know this project token. Check it, or ask for a new one.
There is a server at that address, but it is not a FediFerry server.
The server is in your local network, and FediFerry is not allowed to reach devices there. Allow local network access for FediFerry in Android\'s app settings, then connect again.
